Name: Soundboard
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
This mod adds a menu you can open up that will display every sound there is in the game divided into their relevant categories (Music, Sound Effects, Ambient, and Footsteps). Each page will display up to 10 sounds and will show their sound name, duration, whether or not the sound loops, and whether or not the sound is added or altered by another mod. Clicking on a sound will make it play; you can play multiple sounds at once, even when navigating through different pages or categories.

Optionally, you can have the menu only display vanilla sounds, too. See Configuration below for more details about this feature 

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28870]Install StardewUI[/url]﻿.
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=5]Controller Support[/size][/b]
Controllers are fully supported. Use the left and right triggers to quickly change categories and left and right bumpers to quickly change pages.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
There are three configuration options available in this mod:

1) Open Soundboard: This is your keybind to open the Soundboard menu. Defaults to F3.
2) Force Tooltips: If a cue is too long to display its entire name in your menu, the Soundboard will let you hover over it to display its full name inside a pop-up tooltip. You may turn this option on if you want tooltips to always be shown, even if their names are short enough to already be displayed.
3) Vanilla Only: If this option is turned on and a vanilla sound is altered by another mod, that alteration will be undone while inside the Soundboard menu (and [i]only[/i] while inside the Soundboard menu). This way you can listen to all the vanilla sounds without hunting down every mod in your mod list that might add or alter any.
